texts:
Pick what you want to make, copy the prompt, paste it into Claude, and swap the words in angle brackets for your own.

That is the whole Prompt Library: 24 prompts, each written to produce something real, like a 3D model you can download or a live avatar on your page. 15 of them need nothing installed.

10 are for making 3D: a model from a sentence, a rigged avatar from a description, a rig for a GLB you already have.

Each prompt names the tools to call and what to check before it answers. The rigged avatar one has Claude look at the rendered frames and fix the proportions before it says it is done.

The library is also published as plain text and as JSON, so an agent can read it too.

three.ws/prompts
The prompts that can move real money are written to stop for your yes first.
